description: This file defines the public interface for platform-specific tasks in the ANGLE project, including function pointers for time, logging, tracing, histogram reporting, and platform method management, as well as structures and macros for platform method enumeration and external linkage.

methods.name: DefaultCurrentTime
methods.description: Returns a default implementation of current time in seconds since epoch, currently always 0.0.

methods.name: DefaultMonotonicallyIncreasingTime
methods.description: Returns a default implementation of monotonically increasing time, currently always 0.0.

methods.name: DefaultLogError
methods.description: Default function for logging error messages, does nothing.

methods.name: DefaultLogWarning
methods.description: Default function for logging warning messages, does nothing.

methods.name: DefaultLogInfo
methods.description: Default function for logging info messages, does nothing.

methods.name: DefaultGetTraceCategoryEnabledFlag
methods.description: Returns nullptr, indicating no trace category is enabled by default.

methods.name: DefaultAddTraceEvent
methods.description: Default function for adding trace events, returns 0.

methods.name: DefaultUpdateTraceEventDuration
methods.description: Default function for updating trace event duration, does nothing.

methods.name: DefaultHistogramCustomCounts
methods.description: Default histogram reporting for custom counts, does nothing.

methods.name: DefaultHistogramEnumeration
methods.description: Default histogram reporting for enumeration histograms, does nothing.

methods.name: DefaultHistogramSparse
methods.description: Default histogram reporting for sparse histograms, does nothing.

methods.name: DefaultHistogramBoolean
methods.description: Default histogram reporting for boolean histograms, does nothing.

methods.name: DefaultOverrideWorkaroundsD3D
methods.description: Default override for D3D workarounds, does nothing.

methods.name: DefaultOverrideFeaturesVk
methods.description: Default override for Vulkan features, does nothing.

methods.name: DefaultCacheProgram
methods.description: Default function for caching program binaries, does nothing.
